subject: how to importing the dump of the mysql database in shinyapps.io

messages.author: 278f383cce0757b2
messages.subject: how to importing the dump of the mysql database in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi all,

I have a shiny app which makes queries from a mysql database bases on the users input.
It works properly on my local.
It seems it will also work well on shinyapps.io server but since my shiny app can not connect to mysql for now it is not functional.
The error I got is:
Warning: Error in .local: Failed to connect to database: Error: Can't connect to local MySQL server through socket '/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock' (2)

I am using the free version of the shinyapps.io server.
I deployed my code using rsconnect::deployApp("path_of_my_app")
Is possible to connect the server through the terminal?
Because I need to;
  • copy my .sql file to the server, 
  • create mysql database,
  • import the dump of the mysql (.sql) to my database,
  • create a user,
  • set privileges for this user, ... ,
In the end, I want to be able to run my code below:

shinyServer(
 function(input, output, session){
...
mydb <- dbConnect(MySQL(),user="theuser", password="thepass", dbname="thedatabase", host=options()$mysql$host)
...
})


I am looking forward to hear your suggestions.
Thanks in advance
Best
Cankut

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: how to importing the dump of the mysql database in shinyapps.io
parts:
You cannot run a database on shinyapps.io, but you may connect to your database running elsewhere.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#accessing-databases-with-odbc
